title: A Voyage to Arcturus
author: David Lindsay
description: "A Voyage to Arcturus" by David Lindsay is a novel published in 1920.
longDescription: The book follows Maskull's journey through Tormance, a strange planet orbiting Arcturus, where each landscape represents different philosophical systems and states of consciousness. As Maskull's body transforms with alien organs and he encounters mysterious beings, he searches for the meaning of reality itself.

authorInfo.bio: David Lindsay (1876–1945) is the author of A Voyage to Arcturus. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
